upcoming_earnings.ai_summary_en: TSM is scheduled to report earnings on 2026-10-15 with an EPS estimate of 4.46 and revenue estimate of 45.87B. The company has maintained a perfect historical beat rate of 1.0, following a strong +10.9% surprise in the prior quarter on 2026-06-30.

upcoming_earnings.action_note_en: Monitor TSM position sizing ahead of the 2026-10-15 report given the perfect historical beat record.
upcoming_earnings.action_note_ko: 완벽한 역사적 비트 기록을 감안해 2026-10-15 실적 발표 전 TSM 포지션 규모를 점검하십시오.
